title: Beta
shortDescription: Build Swiggy Instamart carts by voice or text, then review before paying.
fullDescription:
Beta helps you build and review Swiggy Instamart carts by voice or text. Speak or type a grocery list and Beta helps you find available products, review the proposed changes and add only the items you confirm. Voice and text work together, so you can switch between them at any time.

Connect your Swiggy account through Swiggy's secure sign-in page. Beta can show your saved delivery addresses and recent Instamart choices. With optional location permission, your phone can use your current location to rank nearby saved addresses. Beta does not send raw GPS to its backend or analytics. You always choose and confirm the delivery address, and Beta reads a short address confirmation aloud when text-to-speech is available.

Beta searches the address-specific Instamart catalogue, uses recent product choices to rank relevant live results, and shows the exact cart plan before making any change. When checkout is enabled, Beta also shows the full cart, delivery address, fees, total and payment method before you hand off to payment. For UPI, you approve in your UPI app; Beta never asks for a PIN, card number or VPA. If Swiggy returns cash on delivery, Beta can surface that option too. Beta keeps a small reminder for unfinished attempts so you can return to the same review if the app closes. If Beta still cannot safely tell whether the cart update can be distinguished from the existing cart, it stops and asks you to inspect Swiggy yourself instead of retrying automatically.

Beta never sees your Swiggy OTP, PIN, card number or VPA. You tap the final confirmation in Beta to send the order. Payment approval happens in your UPI app, or you can use cash on delivery when Swiggy returns it. Beta does not store raw voice audio.

Optional analytics are off by default. If you opt in, Beta records only pseudonymous usage and crash signals to improve the app. Those signals can also help with ad measurement when your account is set up for it. Grocery requests, products, cart contents, saved addresses, raw GPS and other shopping details are never sent to analytics or ads. You can turn analytics off again in Settings.
